MRT.note: Colocation at the Nouadhibou cable station is optional space and power, not a data centre; the data centres named are in Europe.

facts.fact: Moov Mauritel's BU WAC interconnection catalogue for 2025/2026, published on the regulator's site, says it runs the Mauritanian branch of the West Africa Cable submarine cable landing at the Nouadhibou terminal station, with capacity and IP transit sold to Marseille, Lisbon, Seville and Madrid.

The same catalogue, issued after ARE's non-objection under authorisation 221/2024/ARE/CNR/DTTP of 23 December 2024, offers dedicated capacity and IP transit on the WAC cable at published tariffs to Mauritanian operators, internet service providers and international clients.

MRT.note: No data centre in the country is named.
The WAC cable links Mauritania to Europe, with no African partner or shared arrangement named.
